title: AWS Lambda to Amazon SNS
description: Create a Lambda function that publishes directly to a phone number using SNS

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The SAM template deploys a Lambda function, and the IAM permissions required to publish an SMS message directly to a phone number via SNS.
The Lambda function handler uses the AWS SDK for javascript to send an SMS message using a 10-digit long code (10DLC) as the SMS origination number.

bullets.text: Choosing between messaging services for serverless applications.

testing.headline: Testing
text: Use the AWS CLI to invoke the Lambda function. The function name is in the outputs of the AWS SAM deployment (the key is TopicPublisherFunction):
1. Invoke the Lambda function to publish a message to SNS: aws lambda invoke --function-name ENTER_YOUR_FUNCTION_NAME outfile.txt.

cleanup.headline: Cleanup
text: 2. Confirm the stack has been deleted: aws cloudformation list-stacks --query "StackSummaries[?contains(StackName,'STACK_NAME')].StackStatus"
